body:
compile() (AST -> NfaInstr bytecode) is real and complete: literals, concat, alternation, Star/Plus/Optional, groups (transparent, no capture extraction yet), char classes (ranges+negation), anchors. No backpatch-list needed for Concat/Alt/Optional (explicit exit-threading + returned start-index, standard recursive-descent codegen); Star/Plus's real loop-back edge needed genuine backpatching via vec-set-at!, a real runtime primitive already added previously for world.prn. Found and fixed a real bug in regex/syntax.prn along the way: AnchorKind/CharRange were declared AFTER PatternNode despite being referenced by it -- process_defenum's pre-pass requires earlier-or-self declaration order, silently fell back to untyped void* with no build error. make test 336/336. A real, standalone C test harness (Pike's-VM-style simulator, not part of PARENA) verified 31 (pattern,text,expected) cases across every construct including nested quantifiers/groups -- 31/31 pass, zero ASan findings. Real remaining scope for the founder's own grep/sed/awk ask: is-match/find/find-all (the actual VM runner: live thread-set stepping, epsilon-closure, PC dedup) are still signature-only -- deliberately not rushed as a backtracking walker, which would violate this file's own 'no backtracking, ever' design contract. Commit 62a520a.

⚓ ☃
title: real, working NFA compiler for regex/nfa.prn -- Thompson construction, 31/31 test cases pass
